title: The Bitcoin Lightning Network
quote: The paper describes bidirectional payment channels and HTLCs to route payments across a network while settling disputes on Bitcoin.

title: BOLT: Basis of Lightning Technology
quote: BOLTs define interoperability rules across implementations for channel management, routing, invoices, and related protocol messages.

title: BOLT #2: Peer Protocol for Channel Management
quote: BOLT #2 specifies opening, commitment update, and channel closing message flows between peers.

title: BOLT #3: Bitcoin Transaction and Script Formats
quote: BOLT #3 defines commitment transaction construction and HTLC-success/timeout transaction formats.

title: BOLT #4: Onion Routing Protocol
quote: BOLT #4 specifies onion packet construction and forwarding behavior for multi-hop payments.

title: BOLT #11: Invoice Protocol for Lightning Payments
quote: BOLT #11 defines invoice encoding with payment hash, amount, expiry, and route hints.

title: BOLT #12: Offers Protocol for Lightning Payments
quote: BOLT #12 introduces reusable offers and invoice requests to improve static payment UX compared with one-shot invoices.

title: Atomic Multi-path Payments (AMP)
quote: AMP in lnd splits a payment across multiple shards and supports larger effective payments than a single-path route.

title: Watchtowers
quote: Watchtowers are separate Lightning nodes that monitor channels and can help protect users while their node is offline.

title: lightninglabs/L402: lsat protocol specification
quote: L402 combines macaroons with Lightning invoices and payment hash binding for paid API authentication.

title: L402: Lightning HTTP 402 Protocol
quote: The L402 flow uses HTTP 402 responses carrying invoice and macaroon data, then forwards requests once proof is satisfied.

title: lightninglabs/aperture
quote: Aperture is an HTTP 402 reverse proxy for REST and gRPC backends using the L402 protocol.

title: lnurl/luds: lnurl specifications
quote: LNURL defines interoperable URL-based extensions for Lightning UX, including payRequest and withdraw flows.

title: NIP-47: Nostr Wallet Connect
quote: NIP-47 defines how clients connect to remote Lightning wallet services via Nostr events and connection URIs.

title: Nostr Wallet Connect API
quote: Alby documents practical NIP-47 integration patterns for app-to-wallet payment delegation.

title: An empirical study of availability and reliability properties of the Bitcoin Lightning Network
quote: The study analyzes LN availability and reliability limits driven by node uptime and path uncertainty.

title: Rational Economic Behaviours in the Bitcoin Lightning Network
quote: The paper examines economic incentives of major routing nodes and implications for concentration tendencies.

title: Topology and Network Dynamics of the Lightning Network: A Comprehensive Analysis
quote: The authors reconstruct multi-year topology snapshots and report structural stability and concentration characteristics over time.
